limitations: Source inspection only. No browser walkthrough, API call or screenshot was made.
The V-C26 walkthrough needs new evidence for the Type control. The DOC-029 walkthrough checked Kind and six hand-set kinds, which no longer exist in the staff app.

A Matter or Entity shows no Type control until an Administrator adds a type under Settings, Documents. The walkthrough must add one to exercise Type on those records, or record that the control is absent on a fresh list.
A Generated redline correction cannot be exercised without a Word Comparison export. Source shows the Type cell is read-only for it and the API answers 409.
The Knowledge Type column behavior (a choice that the API refuses) is derived from code, not observed.

The Portal still labels its Contract upload control Kind and offers General plus the six kinds, and shows kind labels on Versions (DOC-015 consequences). This guide does not describe Portal controls; contributor-guide.md does.
